$comment: The landing showcase's pack map: every data-pack boundary on the built export is here.
The bar lockup and the footer lockup are the one brand mark, in the page ground.
The chooser's swatch is the third boundary: the pack the page is wearing, drawn as the
pack's own disc, and the static export carries the ground because a reader's choice is
the reader's and not the server's. The sites switcher's sibling marks live in a closed
dropdown, so the static export carries only the current mark.

header.brand.why: The bar lockup is this site, and its pack is the page ground.

header.theme.why: The chooser's swatch, which shows the pack the page is in.

footer.brand.why: The same lockup in the footer.
